014package org.microbean.scopelet;
015
016import java.lang.constant.Constable;
017import java.lang.constant.ConstantDesc;
018import java.lang.constant.DynamicConstantDesc;
019
020import java.util.Optional;
021
022import static java.lang.constant.ConstantDescs.BSM_INVOKE;
023
024import static java.lang.constant.MethodHandleDesc.ofConstructor;
025
026/**
027 * A {@link MapBackedScopelet} implementation that caches singletons.
028 *
029 * @author <a href="https://about.me/lairdnelson" target="_top">Laird Nelson</a>
030 */
031public class SingletonScopelet extends MapBackedScopelet<SingletonScopelet> implements Constable {
032
033  /**
034   * Creates a new {@link SingletonScopelet}.
035   */
036  public SingletonScopelet() {
037    super();
038  }
039
040  @Override // Constable
041  public Optional<? extends ConstantDesc> describeConstable() {
042    return Optional.of(DynamicConstantDesc.of(BSM_INVOKE, ofConstructor(this.getClass().describeConstable().orElseThrow())));
043  }
044
045}
